correctness.rationale: Exact outer contacts and facet distances give R²=k+(t−k)² and r=min(1,t/√d). Uniform hyperoctahedral orbit covariances of a primal and polar contact give trace lower bounds for every A>0. Cauchy gives universal R/r sharpness with equality only for scalar A. Piecewise derivatives and continuity prove unique t=√d; outside [1,d] the endpoint bodies are homothetic ℓ1/ℓ∞ balls. Standalone rational checks confirmed finite instances without replacing the proof.
